# Planted bugs of pairfile (scripts/go-mutants.sh client/pairfile/testdata/mutants.txt,
# make test-go-mutants, in make ci), in the format of client/orgid/testdata/mutants.txt;
# each is a mutant of spec/pair/MachinePair.tla too.
# key-first: the writer before CERTATOMIC (CERTPAIR), the key over the old one
# before the certificate; stopped between the two, no pair.
key-first | pairfile.go | 		{"next", func() error { return write(p.Next(), key) }}, | 		{"next", func() error { return write(p.Key, key) }}, | TestEveryCrashLeavesAPair
key-first | pairfile.go | 		{"swap", func() error { return rename(p.Next(), p.Key) }}, | 		{"swap", func() error { return nil }}, | TestEveryCrashLeavesAPair
cert-first | pairfile.go | 		{"next", func() error { return write(p.Next(), key) }}, | 		{"next", func() error { return write(p.Cert, cert) }}, | TestEveryCrashLeavesAPair
cert-first | pairfile.go | 		{"cert", func() error { return write(p.Cert, cert) }}, | 		{"cert", func() error { return write(p.Next(), key) }}, | TestEveryCrashLeavesAPair
